reference: Frozen L1 ZERO / RSSF rest geometry, mirrored from R2; angles below are modest audit increments from that curved geometry, not human anatomical standards
idle_target: NO key/home IK for relaxed fingers. Curved RSSF + small deterministic phase-driven flexion; shared palm transport.

temporal_constraints.method: previous legal state plus velocity prediction; intersect per-step velocity/acceleration bounds and braking envelope with joint limits INSIDE IK. No post-smoothing.

whole_hand: single root XYZ/yaw/pitch/roll jointly solved with playing/preparing/releasing fingers; idle fingers transported in that common palm frame; clearance proxies are RSSF palm samples and idle pads
objective_units: contact in mm; natural posture and temporal penalties in rad; root regularization in mm. No effectively-zero prior.
fixed_inputs: copied byte-identical timeline, fingering, keyboard, markers, tolerances and WAV; key angle array copied exactly
stop_loss: one deterministic initialization and one forward constrained trajectory; no restarts, sweeps or alternate versions
